title: Matrices up to Order 3

sections.heading: 1. Symmetric, Skew-Symmetric & Orthogonal Properties
sections.proseLatex: For any square matrix $A$, $A = \frac{1}{2}(A + A^T) + \frac{1}{2}(A - A^T)$. The sum is symmetric and the difference is skew-symmetric.

keyFormulas.label: Commutator of Symmetric Matrices
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Prove using transpose reversal law $(AB)^T = B^T A^T$.

sections.heading: 2. Adjoint, Inverse & Cayley-Hamilton
sections.proseLatex: For a non-singular $3\times3$ matrix, $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj}A$. Cayley-Hamilton: $A$ satisfies its own characteristic equation.

keyFormulas.label: Adjoint Product
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Direct definition of the adjoint matrix.

wbjeebTraps: Scalar determinant trap: $|kA| = k^n|A|$ where $n$ is matrix order.
